record.question: Which of the following best defines an opportunistic infection?
options: Infection caused by highly pathogenic organisms only
Infection acquired in a hospital setting
Infection occurring when normal defenses are weakened
record.explanation: Answer C: Infection occurring when normal defenses are weakened. An opportunistic infection takes advantage of impaired host defenses or a setting that permits infection by an organism that ordinarily causes less disease. Reference: https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/cancer-terms/def/opportunistic-infection. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
